description: Recycled Material Quantities by Material Type is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by Ashghal. This dataset presents monthly data from Ashghal on the quantities of construction and roadwork materials used and the proportion recycled. It includes material types such as asphalt mixes, sub-base and road base, fill and subgrade works, and block works. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher Ashghal. Its tags are recycling, materials, construction, sustainability, roads. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2025-05-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, road safety and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
